ea_timestamped_lineage.rule: For each target, accept survey dates resolution transform and geoid only from the exact intersecting official survey metadata. Dataset-level defaults cannot replace target lineage.

ea_projection_geoid.rule: Keep geometry in EPSG:27700. Composite OSTN15 or post-2016 OSGM15 guidance does not authorize guessing the geoid of an older time-stamped survey.

ea_numeric_route.rule: No parcel elevation statistic may be produced until actual WCS/download raster bytes and a real CoverageId/coverage response are observed.

terrain50_pixel_centre.rule: Secondary Terrain50 samples must use documented 50m pixel centres; never sample tile corners or interpolate an invented value.

terrain50_vertical_metadata.rule: Require per-tile metadata confirming EPSG:27700 and vertical reference, and read earliest/latest flying dates before numeric crosscheck.

terrain50_datum_exception.rule: Most Terrain50 heights use ODN, but local offshore datums exist; target-tile metadata remains authoritative.

hmlr_geometry.rule: Use the exact HMLR polygon in native BNG for raster masking; indicative polygon scope is not a legal-boundary claim.

transport_fail_closed.rule: DNS failure and web safe-open restrictions are client transport failures, not evidence that data does not exist.

numeric_claim.rule: official_numeric_rows remains zero until exact lineage and real raster/archive bytes are available.
